answers.question: How did Dude Wipes perform over Black Friday 2025?
steps: Reading 3,877 Walmart product-days from Histomart, Kompy and RetailerAPI
Isolating Black Friday week (Nov 21 – Dec 1, 2025) against the Oct 1 – Nov 13 baseline
Comparing 16 items across 4 brands on price, crossed-out markdowns, stock and sellers
Ranking the price moves and checking which brands cut
answers.headline: Dude Wipes did not discount for Black Friday 2025 at Walmart: its items moved +6.4% on average (4 of 5 went up), while the rest of the set moved +2.9%. It held price and stayed 100% in stock; nobody in the set ran a broad Black Friday cut at Walmart.
answers.what: Dude Wipes held or raised price on every item through Black Friday week. The deepest cut in the set was Goodwipes Rosewater · 200 ct at -41.6%, while it was out of stock most of the week (0% in stock). No tracked item showed a crossed-out Walmart markdown during the week (0 markdown readings).
answers.why: There was no deal to follow: no Dude Wipes item showed a crossed-out Walmart markdown, and its median item had 1 seller, so no reseller undercut the shelf. Without brand-funded promotion the shelf price simply followed Walmart's own pricing, which drifted up into the holidays.
answers.when: Black Friday was Nov 28, 2025. Prices were read from Nov 21 to Dec 1, 2025 against Oct 1 – Nov 13. The holiday chart runs to Dec 31, 2025.

answers.question: Is Dude Wipes the premium or the value choice per wipe?
steps: Restating 19 Walmart items to price per 100 wipes from their own pack counts
Taking each item's median over Jul 20, 2026 – Oct 18, 2026
Ranking 4 brands and tracing twelve months of the same measure
answers.headline: Dude Wipes is the second most expensive of 4 brands per wipe at Walmart: $8.47 per 100 wipes on its median item, 78.8% above Cottonelle at $4.74. It is priced as a premium wipe, not the value one.
answers.what: Median price per 100 wipes: Cottonelle $4.74, Goodwipes $6.65, Dude Wipes $8.47, Charmin $9.93. The cheapest single item is Cottonelle Fresh Care · 420 ct at $4.22.
answers.why: Pack size drives it: Dude Wipes sells 48, 96, 192, 240-count packs, and its smallest (48 ct) costs $9.54 per 100 wipes against $7.49 for its largest (240 ct). Cottonelle's median item is $4.74.
answers.when: Jul 20, 2026 to Oct 18, 2026 for the ranking; the trend covers Oct 19, 2025 to Oct 18, 2026.

answers.question: Did Dude Wipes compete on Prime Big Deal Days?
steps: Pulling daily Amazon (Keepa) and Walmart prices for 19 tracked listings
Comparing Oct 13, 2026 – Oct 14, 2026 against the 14 days before
Matching measured price events and stock on the event days
answers.headline: Dude Wipes mostly held price on Prime Big Deal Days: its listings moved -0.4% on average against Cottonelle's -4.9%. 1 of 9 Dude Wipes listings cut 3% or more.
answers.what: Dude Wipes -0.4% (1/9 cut) · Charmin +6.6% (1/10 cut) · Cottonelle -4.9% (2/6 cut) · Goodwipes 0.0% (0/10 cut). Dude Wipes ran 0 measured price events overlapping the event.
answers.why: Across the set, Amazon listings moved -0.6% and Walmart listings +2.4% on the event days; Dude Wipes moved -0.9% on Amazon and 0.0% on Walmart. Its priced listings were 100% in stock on the event days, so price, not stock, decided what it sold.
answers.when: Prime Big Deal Days: Oct 13, 2026 – Oct 14, 2026. Baseline: the 14 days before.

answers.question: Where is Dude Wipes losing sales to stock-outs?
steps: Reading daily buyable state for 12 Dude Wipes listing-retailer pairs (Keepa for Amazon, Walmart feed)
Finding every continuous outage in Jul 20, 2026 – Oct 18, 2026
answers.headline: Dude Wipes was in stock 79.7% of the time on Amazon and Walmart, #4 of 4. 2 listings were unavailable the whole quarter (Flushable Wipes · 96 Count on Amazon, Flushable Wet Wipes Dispenser · 192 Count on Amazon); without them the rate is 95.6%.
answers.what: 13 outages cost 214 listing-days. Cottonelle 100.0% · Goodwipes 100.0% · Charmin 94.5% · Dude Wipes 79.7%.
answers.why: A listing with no buyable offer for the whole 91 days is not a short stock-out: it is a listing Amazon is not selling. Fixing those listings, or retiring them, moves the rate more than any replenishment change.

answers.question: What do shoppers love and hate about Dude Wipes?
steps: Counting 22,999 aspect mentions across Amazon and Walmart reviews
Reading 463 Dude Wipes Walmart reviews for the sharpest complaints
answers.headline: Shoppers love Dude Wipes' softness (92% positive) and complain about durability (42% positive, against Goodwipes' 78%). It rates 4.72★, #2 of 4.
answers.what: Softness 92% · Effectiveness 91% · Fragrance 85% · Quality 85% · Size 67% · Durability 42%.
answers.why: Durability is where the brand loses: 1,801 negative mentions against 1,288 positive. Goodwipes scores 78% on the same aspect, so the complaint is about the product, not the category.
answers.when: Amazon review summaries as read on the build date; Walmart reviews from Apr 18, 2025 to Oct 17, 2026.

answers.question: How visible is Dude Wipes in AI shopping answers?
steps: Reading 72 engine answers to 24 shopper questions
Comparing 5 captured readings from Oct 14, 2026 to Oct 21, 2026
Splitting by engine (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) and funnel stage
answers.headline: Dude Wipes holds 14.9% of brand mentions in AI answers, #2 of 4; Cottonelle leads at 21.3%. It is named in 47 of 72 answers, most often by Claude (18 of 24).
answers.what: Cottonelle 21.3% · Dude Wipes 14.9% · Charmin 5.9% · Goodwipes 4.9%. Since Oct 14, 2026 Dude Wipes moved -3.4 points.
answers.why: Being named is not being recommended: Cottonelle is the engines' top pick in 58 of 72 answers, Dude Wipes in 5. ChatGPT names Dude Wipes least often (12 of 24), so that is where the gap is widest.
